title: Reject ambiguous lifecycle timestamps with structured diagnostics
objective: Reject ambiguous lifecycle timestamps with structured diagnostics. Preserve existing owner semantics and historical evidence.

evidence.summary: Independent findings and corrected external-audit claims.
Read-only probes with synthetic temporary fixtures; no paid API calls.

reproduction: Call parse_time with 2026-08-24T12:00:00 and observe a timezone-naive datetime. A receipt mixing that value with an aware timestamp can raise TypeError during ordering instead of returning an invalid result. Use synthetic receipts only.

positive: Z and explicit-offset timestamps compare on the same UTC timeline.
Validation reports missing timezone or malformed time as a structured invalid result, without a traceback.
negative: Naive, malformed or impossible timestamps cannot pass or be silently assigned a timezone.
Do not change horizon rules, infer timestamps or modify historical receipts.

forbidden_changes: restricted provider values in public artifacts
